* `Click-ThroughRates(CTR)` - Formula: (Number of Clicks / Number of Impressions) x 100
Indicates the effectiveness of an ad in generating interest.
* `ConversionRate` - Formula: (Number of Conversions / Number of Total Visitors) x 100
Measures the percentage of users who take the desired action (e.g., make a purchase).
* `CustomerAcquisitionCost(CAC)` - Formula: Total Campaign Costs / Number of New Customers Acquired
Indicates the cost to acquire a new customer.
* `ReturnOnInvestment(ROI)` - Formula: (Net Profit / Campaign Cost) x 100
Measures the profitability of the campaign.
* `CustomerLifetimeValue(CLV)` - Estimates the total revenue a business can expect from a single customer account.
* `EngagementRate` - Formula: (Total Engagements / Total Impressions) x 100
Measures how actively users are engaging with the campaign content.
* `BounceRate` - Formula: (Single Page Sessions / Total Sessions) x 100
Indicates the percentage of visitors who leave the site after viewing only one page.
* `RepeatPurchaseRate` - Formula: (Number of Returning Customers / Total Number of Customers) x 100
Indicates the percentage of customers who make more than one purchase
* `ChurnRate` - Formula: (Number of Customers Lost / Total Number of Customers at Start of Period) x 100
Measures the rate at which customers stop doing business with the company.
